fixes.explanation: That's the one, baker. God says the Israelites "…must no longer offer their sacrifices to the goat demons to which they have prostituted themselves." Then He adds that this "will be a permanent statute for them for the generations to come" (Leviticus 17:7). Permanent, friend. That's not a suggestion taped to the fridge.

Baked just right, friend! Out in the field, a hunter who catches a wild animal or bird that may be eaten "…must drain its blood and cover it with dirt." (Leviticus 17:13). That goes for an Israelite and for a foreigner living among them. Two steps, and God doesn't skip either one. I've followed recipes with less clear instructions than that, and mine had pictures!
